robot.name: Unitree H2
robot.status_notes: Official product page lists base price; deployment evidence is demo/company claim only.

currentness.currentness_notes: Current Unitree H-series humanoid product as of reviewed page.

battery.notes: Official product page lists premium lithium battery with low internal resistance, 15Ah capacity, 0.972KWh energy, and 75.6 V maximum voltage.

hands.description: Base H2 table lists no dexterous hand; H2 EDU lists dexterous hand with multiple model options. Unitree's Gala PR says robots used newly self-developed dexterous hands for prop handling, but does not prove this for the base purchasable H2 configuration.

items: humanoid binocular camera with wide field of view

compute.description: Official page lists PC1 Intel Core i5 for platform capabilities, PC2 Intel Core i7 for custom development, and H2 EDU high-power compute module options up to Jetson AGX Thor at 2070 TOPS.

actuators.description: Official page lists low-inertia high-speed internal-rotor PMSM joint motors, industrial-grade crossed roller bearings, 120 N.m maximum arm-joint torque, and 360 N.m maximum leg-joint torque.

evidence_items.title: Official H2 specs and price
evidence_items.claim: Unitree lists H2 at about 70 kg, 31 DoF, about 3 hours battery, and 29900 USD base price.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Official page lists price, dimensions, weight, DoF, payload, battery capacity/runtime, compute, sensors, motors, and torque.

evidence_items.title: Staged performance demos
evidence_items.claim: Public H2 demos show poses, pirouettes, karate-style moves, and staged martial-arts performance claims.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Live Science, Unitree PR, and CGTN describe H2/G1 martial-arts performance appearances and H2's main/sub-venue role.
evidence_items.source_location: Live Science report, Unitree PR, and CGTN video report
evidence_items.verification_notes: Treat autonomy and choreographic generalization cautiously; the clearest autonomy claim comes from Unitree's own PR.

evidence_items.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala H2 appearance
evidence_items.claim: Unitree and CGTN report that H2 appeared at the 2026 China Media Group Spring Festival Gala main venue and Yiwu sub-venue, including a sword-grandmaster role and a Great Sage/Somersault Cloud staging with B2W robot dogs.
evidence_items.notes: Event appearance corroborated by Unitree PR and CGTN; still a staged broadcast performance rather than field deployment.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Supports staged whole-body motion and human-facing performance context only.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Unitree describes H2's main-venue and Yiwu appearances; CGTN separately reports H2's debut at both venues and Somersault Cloud staging.
evidence_items.source_location: Unitree PR sections II-III; CGTN video article
evidence_items.verification_notes: No raw continuous footage, teleoperation disclosure, or task-success metrics found.
